name: Terry Fong
life: “I still remember emptying my refund purse for a frightened visitor.” People around the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio know Terry by a small Saturday habit. Terry notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I took deposits for sunset lessons. I'll refund the ones I can't teach even if it means losing my room.
appearance: Terry has a smooth side part with one rebellious curl, heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw, and a favorite piece of clothing, a long navy raincoat. It usually goes with a seam let out by a narrow strip of contrasting fabric. When somebody else has the floor, Terry takes off the watch before a long conversation.
personality: Likes beautiful, unnecessary things and gets cross with people who mistake poverty for a lack of taste. Terry takes longer choosing a cheap birthday card than an expensive coat.
agenda: To refund buyers whose lessons cannot run.
family: Winifred Bell is Terry’s stepsibling. Terry offers the first invitation. Winifred gets to change the plan. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The return of a witness*, Winifred says, “I am her daughter. I know why we moved and I still miss the tree outside my first bedroom.”
connections: Jesse Ngo. A server putting the date on a board helps a teacher stop selling lessons after that date.

reactions.situation: A visitor demands a refund after the season ends early
reactions.response: Terry checks the actual dates printed on the booking before discussing its refund.

reactions.situation: Smoke appears under a shop door after closing
reactions.response: Terry gets the people at the next doorway away from the smoke and asks a bystander to make the call.
